rationale: Micah's work on visual interfaces for machine learning and AI tooling at IntentiveAI could benefit from insights on creator-focused product marketing and consumer platforms—Weiru's expertise at ByteDance building products for massive creator communities. While they approach AI from different angles (Micah on developer tooling and visual intuition, Weiru on consumer adoption), there's potential to explore how beautiful, human-focused data products and creative platforms intersect in the AI space.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Weiru @Creative Community—you're both thinking about how to make AI interfaces resonate with users, from different vantage points (Micah on visual tooling, Weiru on creator platforms at ByteDance).
